svg.text: Shelf sensor node: perfboard layout (Adafruit Perma-Proto half-size)
Top view, parts side. The board is wired like a breadboard: holes a–e of a row are one connection, f–j another, and each rail runs the whole length.
Gold squares are male header pins. Each takes a female-to-male jumper to that Uno pin; the jumpers leave the board and touch nothing else on it.
Resistors stand on end, hole c:
Links (short wires), hole a to rail:
Top rails and rows 27–30 are unused.
